summary: A POLICY published beside the kit: a product's persistent memory POINTS, never copies. Every runtime is told so on every turn; every `check` on a working clone reads each served product's memory home and refuses a note that holds a secret (the host's edit gates, applied to the note) or copies a line the repository already holds (one source of truth). Codex declares no memory home outside the repository, so nothing there is measured -- and that is said.
